title: Reporter reflects on Trump banning CNN, MS Now and Politico
text:
Washington Examiner White House reporter Naomi Lim said President Donald Trump’s ban on more media outlets from the White House appeared to be a “shoot from the hip” announcement.

“It was actually really lovely to be a part of this press pool,” Lim said on NewsNation’s The Hill Sunday with Chris Stirewalt on Sunday. “We have to keep needling him because the issue is that I don’t think that they actually quite understood what this ban was.”
